title: Predicting the Risk of Incident Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Chinese Elderly Using Machine Learning Techniques.
summary: Retrospective Wuhan cohort of 127,031 adults >65 with incident T2DM follow-up; four algorithms, LASSO-selected 21 features, 80/20 split. XGBoost test AUC 0.7805, sensitivity 0.6452, specificity 0.7577, accuracy 0.7503.
ai_technology: §2.5: LASSO, LR/DT/RF/XGBoost; training-only undersampling and hyperparameter tuning.

evidence.unknown: Random held-out subset of the same cohort; no independent cohort validation, moderate discrimination.
